name: The Survival of Sarah Rose
source:
The Survival of Sarah Rose is an epic-fantasy erotic visual novel, following the life of the eldest daughter of the royal Rose family. When tragedy strikes, Sarah finds her once safe and stable life thrown into chaos. 

[From [url=https://happydaedalus.itch.io/the-survival-of-sarah-rose]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《The Survival of Sarah Rose》是一部史诗奇幻成人视觉小说，讲述罗丝王室长女萨拉·罗丝的一生。悲剧降临时，萨拉原本安全稳定的生活，也被彻底卷入混乱。

[摘自[url=https://happydaedalus.itch.io/the-survival-of-sarah-rose]itch.io[/url]]
